meta.title: Session migration
meta.description: In Settings → Session migration, manage old sessions and whole workspaces with two tabs: Sessions to migrate and Migrated sessions. The range supports 0–120, defaulting to 1 month ago; 0 means all sessions including this month, with 1/3/6-month and all-sessions quick ranges. Sessions with a note or todo are kept by default and must be explicitly allowed and selected. The Migrate whole workspaces panel in the migration tab moves every session of one workspace at once (ignoring the time range) and removes its DSH workspace registration when all of them moved (the project directory is not moved); the archive tab lists migrated workspaces and restoring one recreates the registration and reattaches its sessions, while restoring ordinary sessions also recreates their archived workspace. Both tabs group by workspace and then by last activity month, with workspaces and months collapsed by default, showing Git branch, parent session, note/todo text and DSH archive state; the migrated list also supports searching by title, path, workspace, note or session id. The default archive directory is $DSH_HOME/session-migrator/archive; another absolute directory can be entered manually.
